whatIs: Unicorn Icons is a collection of more than 500 animated icons for applications, delivered as Lottie and Rive. They can also be exported to SVG, GIF, WebM and PNG.
It's a good fit when you want micro-interactions in the interface without animating each icon by hand, and you work with React, Vue, React Native, iOS, Android, Flutter or HTML.
uses: Animating loading, confirmation or error buttons in a web app with lottie-react.
Bringing an onboarding screen in a mobile app to life with Flutter or iOS.
Exporting an icon to GIF or WebM for a demo or an email.
caveats: The free plan includes 100 icons and requires a visible credit to Unicorn Icons; the paid plans remove the attribution.
You need a Lottie or Rive player in your project, which adds a dependency.
On any plan, you can't hand the icons over to clients as standalone files or let your app's users extract them.
pricingNote: Free Starter with 100 icons; the Solo, Team and Enterprise plans (1, 5 or unlimited seats) are one-time payments.
idealFor: Developers who want ready-to-use animated icons for web and mobile.
